source.section: Schedule M line 47 Senior Citizen Deduction columns (a)-(d) (PDF p.6; instructions PDF p.29; example PDF p.30; PDF p.23 'Taxpayers over age 65 or disabled'; Tax Division page: 'You receive the higher of the $8,000 modification or the sum of various itemized decreasing modifications'); Schedule M line 32 Military Retirement Modification (PDF p.5; instructions PDF p.28; PDF p.22 'Certain State and Federal Retirement Systems'); IT-140 lines 1-8 (PDF p.3; instructions PDF p.26: exemptions 2,000 each, line 7 floored at zero); Rate Schedules I and II (PDF p.37); Tax Table (PDF p.38 on)

worked: Single, age 66, military retirement 12,000: line 32 alone is over 8,000, so line 47 is zero (in the projection the 8,000 is reduced by the military retirement to nothing). filer born 1959-09-15, age 66 at December 31, 2025. Federal AGI (given) = private pension 20,000.00 + military retirement 12,000.00 = 32,000.00. Federal taxable income (given, not tested) = 32,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 aged 65 or older = 14,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IT-140 line 1 federal AGI 32,000.00. Schedule M additions lines 51-58 none; IT-140 line 2 0.00. Schedule M Column A: line 32 military retirement 12,000.00 (in full, no cap); line 47 (age 66): column (c) income not on lines 35-46 = 32,000.00, limited to 8,000.00: 8,000.00; column (d) lines 29-34 = 12,000.00; line 47 = 8,000.00 - 12,000.00, less than zero, so 0.00; line 49 = 12,000.00. Line 50 total subtractions = 12,000.00. Projection (per person): The filer: Social Security subtraction 0.00; age 65 deduction = lesser of (8,000.00 - military retirement 12,000.00) and own income 32,000.00 = 0.00; best_of_group wv_line_47 keeps the larger, 0.00 (wv_social_security). Projection subtractions total 12,000.00, the same as line 50. IT-140 line 3 subtractions 12,000.00; line 4 West Virginia AGI = 32,000.00 + 0.00 - 12,000.00 = 20,000.00. Line 5 Low-Income Earned Income Exclusion: federal AGI over 10,000, none. Line 6 exemptions 1 x 2,000.00 = 2,000.00. Line 7 taxable income = 20,000.00 - 2,000.00 = 18,000.00. Line 8 tax by Rate Schedule I (PDF p.37) bands: 2.22% x 10,000.00 = 222 + 2.96% x 8,000.00 = 236.8; total 458.8 = 458.80. The Tax Table row 18,000 to under 18,100 (PDF p.38 on) gives 460; expected keeps the schedule formula on the exact income. No Family Tax Credit (Modified Federal AGI above the table limits); credits 0.00; state income tax 458.80.
accepted_approximations: Tax below 100,000 of taxable income is figured on the exact income, where the booklet uses a Tax Table row's midpoint rounded to the whole dollar. Other tax is also rounded to the whole dollar in the booklet.
